summary: Applied both blocking spec review findings by defining the execution-root plus runId handoff contract and a recovery candidate selectability rule.

items.title: Selected runId is specified as a guard but not as a continuation resolver
items.rationale: Specified that selected recovery continuation uses the candidate execution root plus `--expect-run-id`, not global runId lookup or normal active-flow registration.
items.evidence: spec.json overview.data_flow, overview.decisions, R4, R5, clarifications, and task notes now state execution-root handoff.

items.title: Recovery candidate states do not define which runId-bearing candidates are continuable
items.target: Overview Data Flow / R2 / R3 / Acceptance Criteria
items.rationale: Added a selectability rule: active and orphan-worktree candidates are continuable only with runId and execution root; stale, finalized, branch-only, and missing-runId candidates are display-only/blocked.
items.evidence: spec.json overview.data_flow, R3, acceptance criteria, clarifications, and T-2 acceptance now define selectability by candidate state.
